info.title: Moxie Universal API
info.description: Manage clients, projects, invoices, and payments

post.description: Applies a payment to an invoice in Moxie.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice number to apply the payment to.

clientName.description: Client name tied to the invoice.

paymentType.description: Optional payment type enum. Use one of OTHER, VENMO, PAYPAL, APP_PAYOUT, CREDIT_CARD, CHECK, ZELLE, STRIPE, BANK_TRANSFER, or CASH.

post.description: Creates a new expense in Moxie.

paid.description: Whether the expense has been paid.
